paper.title: Streaming kernel regression with provably adaptive mean, variance, and regularization

settings.name_in_paper: Kernelized bandits with unknown noise variance (Kernel UCB)
unmapped: learner knows an upper bound sigma_+ >= sigma and a lower bound sigma_- <= sigma on the noise level; noise variance itself unknown
settings.definition_quote: At each time step $t \geq 1$, a bandit algorithm recommends a point $x_t$ to sample and observes a noisy outcome $y_t = f_\star(x_t) + \xi_t$, where $\xi_t \sim \Normal(0, \sigma^2)$. ... minimizes the cumulative regret $\kR_T = \sum_{t=1}^T f_\star(\star) - f_\star(x_t)$.

settings.name_in_paper: Kernelized bandits with unknown noise variance, discrete arm set (Kernel TS)
unmapped: learner knows an upper bound sigma_+ >= sigma and a lower bound sigma_- <= sigma on the noise level; noise variance itself unknown
settings.definition_quote: We assume that the set of arms $\bX$ is \emph{discrete}. ... observes a noisy outcome $y_t = f_\star(x_t) + \xi_t$, where $\xi_t \sim \Normal(0, \sigma^2)$.

algorithms.name: Kernel UCB with adaptive regularization and variance estimation
Kernel TS with adaptive variance estimation and regularization tuning

symbols.sigma_plus: known upper bound on the noise standard deviation sigma
symbols.gamma_T_minus: information gain gamma_T(sigma_-^2/C^2) with regularization sigma_-^2/C^2, sigma_- a known lower bound on sigma

tuning: lambda_t = sigma_{+,t}^2/C^2 adaptively tuned via Corollary 3.1

source.label: thm:KernelUCB
source.quote: With probability higher than $1-\delta$, the regret of Kernel UCB with adaptive regularization and variance estimation satisfies for all $T\geq0$ ... $\kR_T \leq 2\sum_{t=1}^T\sqrt{\frac{k_{\lambda_t,t-1}(x_t,x_t)}{\lambda_t}} B_{\lambda_t,t-1}(\delta/4)$. In particular, we have $\kR_T \leq 2\frac{\sigma_+}{\sigma}\Big(1 + \sqrt{2\ln(4/\delta) + 2 \gamma_T(\sigma_{-}^2/C^2)}\big)C \sqrt{T \frac{2\gamma_T(\sigma^2/C^2) }{\ln(1 + C^2/\sigma^2)} }$.

results.notes: Regret is pseudo-regret on f_star values but bound holds w.p. >= 1-delta, so recorded as high-probability regret. Data-dependent first bound not recorded separately. Proof's probability bookkeeping (1-4delta vs 1-delta) is slightly inconsistent.

bound.expression_latex: C_{1,T}\frac{\sigma_+}{\sigma}\Big( 1 +\sqrt{2\ln(4/\delta) + 2 \gamma_T(\sigma_-^2/C^2)} \Big)  C\sqrt{T \frac{2 \gamma_T(\sigma^2/C^2)}{\ln(1 + C^2/\sigma^2)}} +C_2 R\sqrt{T \ln(1/\delta)} + 4\pi e R \delta

symbols.sigma_plus: known upper bound on the noise standard deviation sigma
symbols.R_max: maximal instantaneous pseudo-regret max_x f_star(star) - f_star(x)

conditions: discrete arm set with K = |X| arms

source.label: thm:kernel_ts
source.quote: Assume that the maximal instantaneous pseudo-regret $R=\max_{x\in\bX}\big(f_\star(\star)-f_\star(x)\big)$ is finite. Then, the regret of Kernel TS ... with $v_t = \frac{B_{\lambda_t,t-1}(\delta/4)}{\sigma_{+,t-1}}$ ... with probability $1-3\delta$, the regret is bounded for all $T\geq0$ ... where $C_{1,T} = (4\sqrt{\pi e}+1)\bigg(1+\sqrt{2\ln\Big(\frac{T(T+1) |\bX|}{\sqrt{\pi}\delta}\Big)}\bigg)$ and $C_2=\sqrt{ 8 \pi e(1 + \delta\sqrt{4\pi e})^2}$.

results.notes: Probability 1-3delta. C_{1,T} and C_2 substituted. K = |X|.

conditions: discrete arm set with K = |X| arms

source.label: thm:kernel_ts
source.quote: the regret of Kernel TS (Algorithm~\ref{alg:kernel_ts}) with $v_t = \frac{B_{\lambda_t,t-1}(\delta/4)}{\sigma_{+,t-1}}$ after $T$ episodes is $\cO(C \sqrt{T \ln(T |\bX|)} \gamma_T(\sigma^2/C^2))$ with probability $1 - 3 \delta$.

results.notes: Order statement from the theorem; not fully consistent with the explicit bound (which has gamma_T under square roots and mixed regularizations).
